description: Current v7 float-proxy adapter ablation suite. This matrix keeps the 3-class GNN task as the main line and evaluates architecture, feature, and training ablations on the latest clean relabeled graph set. It does not change the generator; generator/E2E comparisons are run separately with the canonical IR renderer.

experiments.name: M06_current_main_merge_gate
experiments.hypothesis: The current locked main model balances MERGE precision and PARENT_CHILD quality with a Y-network, type-aware message propagation, and hard MERGE gate.
experiments.purpose: Main model for paper-facing current experiments.

experiments.name: M05_no_merge_gate
experiments.hypothesis: Removing the MERGE gate should increase false positive contractions and reduce production safety.
experiments.purpose: Y-network + type-aware message mask without class-specific MERGE suppression.

experiments.name: M07_gaussian_edge_feature
experiments.hypothesis: Gaussian proximity should provide an additional physical locality cue for the PARENT/NONE branch.
experiments.purpose: Main model plus runtime gaussian_proximity derived from center_distance.

experiments.name: A00_old_shared_gat
experiments.hypothesis: The old shared-head GAT underperforms the Y-network because MERGE and PARENT_CHILD need different information paths.

experiments.name: A01_no_message_passing
experiments.hypothesis: No message passing should protect local MERGE features but weaken hierarchy and attachment decisions.
experiments.purpose: Classify from projected local node/edge features only.

experiments.name: A02_no_type_aware_message_mask
experiments.hypothesis: Allowing all candidate edges to propagate messages should increase message pollution from float/table/noise nodes.

experiments.name: F00_no_scibert
experiments.hypothesis: Without SciBERT, semantic continuation and ambiguous local attachment should degrade.
experiments.purpose: Zero only the semantic feature group.

experiments.name: F01_no_geometry_layout
experiments.hypothesis: Without geometry/layout features, column, float, and hierarchy cues should degrade.
experiments.purpose: Keep semantic/type cues and remove most layout evidence.

experiments.name: F02_no_v7_reading_flow
experiments.hypothesis: Removing repaired v7 reading-flow cues should reveal the value of band/column flow reconstruction.
experiments.purpose: Remove sequence, scroll, column, layout-layer, flow-context and matching edge flow cues.

experiments.name: E00_no_punctuation
experiments.hypothesis: Terminal punctuation and hyphen probes are important MERGE boundary cues.
experiments.purpose: Remove source punctuation and hyphen edge probes.

experiments.name: E01_no_gutter_overlap
experiments.hypothesis: Y-overlap and gutter cues suppress cross-column false MERGE.
experiments.purpose: Remove y-overlap and x-gutter edge features.

experiments.name: T00_no_ohem
experiments.hypothesis: Without OHEM, the long-tail NONE distribution should wash out positive relations.
experiments.purpose: Current model trained with ordinary weighted CE only.
